digest.component_or_area: test suite / Jira DC transport and pagination
propositions: Five tests across four modules have assertions that cannot fail or re-implement logic inline instead of calling shared predicates.
test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport constructs a transport that never receives a PAT and tests against the class's default object repr, not a credential-leaking one.

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default, which has no parameter to accept synthetic source.
test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username asserts only hasattr presence, identical to the existing parametrized membership test, and never checks the return value contract.

test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 asserts total <= 1 client calls (satisfied by 0 if member raises before reaching client) and uses blanket pytest.raises(Exception) instead of specific type and code check.
test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error only pins class relationship (not issubclass(BackendRegistryError, KeyError)) and never exercises select_backend behavior.
